request.style: English, gentle folk, clear female vocal with soft male harmony, acoustic guitar, fiddle, dobro, upright bass, flowing like a river, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Down from Galilee he came along the river road
To the muddy Jordan where the crowds and waters flowed
John tried to stop him at the edge, for he knew who it must be
I need to be baptized by you, and yet you come to me

[Verse]
Let it be so for now, the Teacher answered low
To fulfill all righteousness, this is the way to go
So John took him in the river, down beneath the stream
And Jesus rose up out of it like waking from a dream

[Chorus]
This is my beloved Son
In whom I am well pleased
Heaven opened, the Spirit came down
Like a dove, like a dove

[Verse]
The day after, John saw him walking on the shore
And he called out to the people what he had come for
Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world
I have seen it, and I testify, he is the Chosen One of God

[Chorus]
This is my beloved Son
In whom I am well pleased
Heaven opened, the Spirit came down
Like a dove, like a dove

[Bridge]
And behold, the heavens were opened
And he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove
And coming upon him

[Outro]
This is my beloved Son
In whom I am well pleased
